sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2015. Change Request 2015-008 [lce] (submitted by Karl Anderbeck, adopted 2016-01-15). SIL International.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on phonology; adds the names Sekak/Sekah and lists the literature: Anderbeck & Tadmor ms 'Language assimilation among the Sea People of Belitung', Ecoma Verstege 1877, Napsin et al. 1981, Riedel 1881.

sources.citation: Anderbeck, Karl. 2012. The Malayic-speaking Orang Laut: Dialects and directions for research. Wacana, Journal of the Humanities of Indonesia 14(2): 265-312. DOI 10.17510/wacana.v14i2.64
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Section 1.4.4 Sekak (pp. 275-277) and the comparative-phonology sections (pp. 285-300) discuss segmental/historical features of Sekak 1881 vs 1981 (final *h, penultimate vowel changes, Javanese loans, non-Malay lexicon); zero hits for stress/accent/prosody/intonation in the full text. States that the Pusat Bahasa book (Napsin et al. 1981) is the only grammatical description and that Anderbeck & Tadmor ms is historical-linguistic.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en, id): Loncong language / Bahasa Loncong; Crossref, DOAJ, archive.org, Google Books, HathiTrust searches
sources.note: No phonological information; references only Anderbeck 2012, Blench 2016, Ethnologue, Glottolog. Crossref query for Sekak/Suku Laut returns only Bangka Malay (Melayu Bangka) phonology and ethnography papers, none on Sekak. Google Books: Napsin 1981 not digitised. archive.org: no scan.

sources.citation: Napsin, Syahrul, Zainal Abidin Naning, Selamet Abdullah & Zulkarnain Mustafa. 1981. Struktur bahasa Sekak. Jakarta: Pusat Pembinaan dan Pengembangan Bahasa. xv+192 pp.

sources.note: The only grammatical description of Sekak; Pusat Bahasa 'Struktur bahasa' volumes routinely include a Fonologi chapter with a 'Tekanan' subsection stating stress placement. Open PDF (40 MB, Adobe ClearScan with text layer) at the ministry repository; host unreachable today (timeout/ECONNREFUSED); Internet Archive copy truncated at 1 MiB. Re-download from a network that can reach Indonesian.go.id hosts, or from a copy of the repository mirror.
